description: A boxed set of books sits upright on the bed in front of a large pillow, with space on the right side of the bed to place items. The left hand stays resting on the bed while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips one book from the box and pulls it out to set it down on the bed to the right, then pulls out another book and places it down near the first before removing a third book and laying it closer to the front; throughout, each removed book becomes a right-hand object during the lift and is released once it’s placed on the bed.
